AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions: DJ Mini plays music files saved on this device. Its function plays one song that matches a title, an artist, or an album, and then keeps playing songs that sound like it. Constraints: - Only music files saved on this device can be played; streaming services are not available. - One call starts one song; after it, DJ Mini picks each next song by how much it sounds like the song before, and never plays a song twice until the next call.
